name: Port Authority of Thailand (PAT)
via: state enterprise under the Ministry of Transport
note: State enterprise of Thailand under the Ministry of Transport, established by the Port Authority of Thailand Act B.E. 2494 (1951); operator of Thailand's seaports. The PAT seal is on the front of Port FC's 2026-27 home shirt above the manufacturer logo, and PAT heads the club's own list of 19 official sponsors for 2026/27.
